title: 1925 Doble E-20 Steam Car - Jay Leno's Garage
summary: Jay Leno tours and drives a 1925 Doble E-20 steam car, once owned by Howard Hughes, covering how it starts up and runs. It includes a cutaway view of the engine.
why: Cited in steam car threads as a well-produced view of how a Doble works and how it solved startup in 1925.

quote.text: The video has great production and really shows the starting and driving processes
